definitions.explanation: A reference book or digital resource listing words and their meanings, often with translations or detailed explanations.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}で{意味|いみ}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: Look up the meaning in a dictionary.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}{辞書|じしょ}は{便利|べんり}だ。
{和英|わえい}{辞書|じしょ}を{使|つか}って{翻訳|ほんやく}する。

notes:
{辞書|じしょ} is a compound: {辞|じ} (words) + {書|しょ} (book).

TYPES OF {辞書|じしょ}:
- {国語|こくご}{辞書|じしょ}/{辞典|じてん} (Japanese dictionary)
- {英和|えいわ}{辞書|じしょ} (English-Japanese)
- {和英|わえい}{辞書|じしょ} (Japanese-English)
- {漢字|かんじ}{辞典|じてん} (kanji dictionary)
- {電子|でんし}{辞書|じしょ} (electronic dictionary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辞書|じしょ}を{引|ひ}く (to look up in a dictionary)
- {辞書|じしょ}で{調|しら}べる (to check in a dictionary)
- {辞書|じしょ}を{使|つか}う (to use a dictionary)

NOTE:
{辞書|じしょ} and {辞典|じてん} are often interchangeable, though {辞典|じてん} can feel slightly more formal or comprehensive (like an encyclopedia).
